· Position vs SMA100/200 ($128.33/$121.73) — good mid-to-long term trend strength

· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -1.0297 → -1.1575) — weak convergence maintained, no trend reversal signal

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — conditions met for watching
